# Riferimento dei metodi

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_reference.py from the engine registry. Do not edit. -->

Ogni metodo è disponibile con lo stesso identificativo e gli stessi input da Python
(`fm.run`), dalla CLI (`fairmark run`), via MCP e function calling (nome del tool
`fairmark_<id con underscore>`). I decimali si passano come numeri JSON o stringhe e
sono restituiti come stringhe. Le descrizioni dei campi provengono dal codice
sorgente e sono in inglese.

## `dates.year_fraction`

**Year fraction (day count)** · versione del metodo 1 · stato disponibile · tool `fairmark_dates_year_fraction`

Fraction of a year between two dates under an ISDA 2006 day-count convention: Actual/365 Fixed, Actual/360, Actual/Actual ISDA, 30/360, 30E/360.

| Input | Tipo | Obbligatorio | Default | Descrizione |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `start` | string | sì |  | Start date (ISO 8601). |
| `end` | string | sì |  | End date (ISO 8601), not earlier than the start date. |
| `day_count` | `act_365_fixed` \| `act_360` \| `act_act_isda` \| `thirty_360` \| `thirty_e_360` | sì |  | Day-count convention. |

## `rates.convert`

**Rate conversion between compounding conventions** · versione del metodo 1 · stato disponibile · tool `fairmark_rates_convert`

Equivalent annual rate under another compounding (annual, semi-annual, quarterly, monthly, continuous).

| Input | Tipo | Obbligatorio | Default | Descrizione |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `rate` | decimale | sì |  | Annual rate as a decimal fraction (0.12 = 12% a year), quoted with `from` compounding. |
| `from` | `annual` \| `semi_annual` \| `quarterly` \| `monthly` \| `continuous` | sì |  | Compounding of the given rate. |
| `to` | `annual` \| `semi_annual` \| `quarterly` \| `monthly` \| `continuous` | sì |  | Compounding of the equivalent rate to return. |

## `rates.real_nominal`

**Real and nominal rates (Fisher)** · versione del metodo 1 · stato disponibile · tool `fairmark_rates_real_nominal`

Converts a nominal rate to a real rate, or the reverse, with the exact Fisher relation.

| Input | Tipo | Obbligatorio | Default | Descrizione |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `rate` | decimale | sì |  | Rate to convert, decimal fraction per period (0.08 = 8%). |
| `inflation` | decimale | sì |  | Inflation over the same period, decimal fraction (0.03 = 3%). |
| `direction` | `to_real` \| `to_nominal` | sì |  | `to_real` or `to_nominal`. |

## `tvm.npv`

**Net present value** · versione del metodo 2 · stato disponibile · tool `fairmark_tvm_npv`

Net present value of a cash flow series; the first flow is at t = 0.

| Input | Tipo | Obbligatorio | Default | Descrizione |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `rate` | decimale | sì |  | Discount rate per period as a decimal fraction (0.10 = 10%). |
| `cash_flows` | lista di decimale | sì |  | Cash flows; the first one occurs at t = 0 (no discounting). |

## `tvm.present_value`

**Present value with a constant or time-varying rate** · versione del metodo 1 · stato disponibile · tool `fairmark_tvm_present_value`

Present value of periodic flows for periods 1..n with one rate or one rate per period, at end, mid or beginning of period. Returns every discount factor.

| Input | Tipo | Obbligatorio | Default | Descrizione |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `cash_flows` | lista di decimale | sì |  | Cash flows of periods 1, 2, ..., n, in currency units. |
| `rate` | decimale | no |  | One discount rate for every period, decimal fraction per period. Give exactly one of `rate` and `period_rates`. |
| `period_rates` | array \| null | no |  | One discount rate per period (forward period rates, decimal fractions), exactly one per cash flow. |
| `timing` | `end_of_period` \| `mid_period` \| `beginning_of_period` | sì |  | When flows occur within each period. |

## `tvm.xnpv`

**Net present value of dated cash flows (XNPV)** · versione del metodo 1 · stato disponibile · tool `fairmark_tvm_xnpv`

Present value of dated flows at a valuation date, with explicit day count and compounding (defaults as in ECMA-376 XNPV).

| Input | Tipo | Obbligatorio | Default | Descrizione |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `rate` | decimale | sì |  | Annual discount rate, decimal fraction (0.09 = 9%), quoted with `compounding`. |
| `cash_flows` | lista di object | sì |  | Dated cash flows, in any order. |
| `valuation_date` |  | no |  | Date at which the value is computed. Default: the earliest flow date (ECMA-376 XNPV). |
| `day_count` |  | no |  | Day count for the time between dates. Default: `act_365_fixed` (ECMA-376 XNPV). |
| `compounding` |  | no |  | Compounding of `rate`. Default: `annual` (ECMA-376 XNPV). |

## `tvm.irr`

**Internal rate of return** · versione del metodo 2 · stato disponibile · tool `fairmark_tvm_irr`

Rate at which the NPV of a periodic cash flow series is zero, solved deterministically; refuses inputs with more than one IRR.

| Input | Tipo | Obbligatorio | Default | Descrizione |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `cash_flows` | lista di decimale | sì |  | Cash flows; the first one occurs at t = 0. Needs at least one sign change. |
| `guess` | decimale | no |  | Starting point for Newton's method, decimal fraction per period. Default: 0.10. |

## `tvm.xirr`

**Internal rate of return of dated cash flows (XIRR)** · versione del metodo 1 · stato disponibile · tool `fairmark_tvm_xirr`

Annual rate at which the XNPV of dated flows is zero, solved deterministically; refuses inputs with more than one rate.

| Input | Tipo | Obbligatorio | Default | Descrizione |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `cash_flows` | lista di object | sì |  | Dated cash flows, in any order; at least one positive and one negative amount. |
| `day_count` |  | no |  | Day count for the time between dates. Default: `act_365_fixed` (ECMA-376 XIRR). |
| `compounding` |  | no |  | Compounding of the returned rate. Default: `annual` (ECMA-376 XIRR). |
| `guess` | decimale | no |  | Starting point for Newton's method, annual decimal fraction. Default: 0.10 (ECMA-376 XIRR). |

## `tvm.mirr`

**Modified internal rate of return (MIRR)** · versione del metodo 1 · stato disponibile · tool `fairmark_tvm_mirr`

Rate of return with negative flows financed at a finance rate and positive flows reinvested at a reinvestment rate (ECMA-376 MIRR).

| Input | Tipo | Obbligatorio | Default | Descrizione |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `cash_flows` | lista di decimale | sì |  | Periodic cash flows; the first one occurs at t = 0. At least one positive and one negative. |
| `finance_rate` | decimale | sì |  | Rate paid on the money invested (applied to negative flows), decimal fraction per period. |
| `reinvest_rate` | decimale | sì |  | Rate earned on reinvested positive flows, decimal fraction per period. |

## `tvm.future_value`

**Future value of a present amount and level payments** · versione del metodo 1 · stato disponibile · tool `fairmark_tvm_future_value`

Value at the end of n periods of a present amount and a level series of payments, ordinary or due, at a rate per period.

| Input | Tipo | Obbligatorio | Default | Descrizione |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `present_value` | decimale | no |  | Amount at t = 0, in currency units, accumulated to t = n. Default: 0. Give at least one of `present_value` and `payment`. |
| `payment` | decimale | no |  | Level payment of every period, in currency units. Default: 0. An amount of the same sign as the present value accumulates in the same direction; a negative amount is a withdrawal. |
| `rate` | decimale | sì |  | Rate per period, decimal fraction (0.01 = 1% per period). No annual-rate conversion: for an annual rate, convert it first (`rates.convert`) and divide by the periods per year. |
| `periods` | integer | sì |  | Number of periods, from 1 to 10000. |
| `timing` | `ordinary` \| `due` | sì |  | `ordinary` (payments at the end of each period) or `due` (at the beginning). |

## `loans.instalment`

**Loan instalment (constant instalment, optional balloon)** · versione del metodo 1 · stato disponibile · tool `fairmark_loans_instalment`

Constant instalment of a loan from its principal, rate, number of instalments and timing, with an optional balloon amount and an explicit rounding.

| Input | Tipo | Obbligatorio | Default | Descrizione |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `principal` | decimale | sì |  | Amount borrowed, in currency units, greater than zero. |
| `rate` | decimale | no |  | Annual borrowing rate, decimal fraction (0.05 = 5% a year), quoted with `compounding`. Rate form (a): give it with `compounding` and `payment_frequency`, or give `periodic_rate` instead. |
| `compounding` |  | no |  | Compounding of `rate` (form a); required with `rate`, no default. |
| `payment_frequency` |  | no |  | Instalments per year (form a): `annual`, `semi_annual`, `quarterly` or `monthly`. |
| `periodic_rate` | decimale | no |  | Rate per payment period, decimal fraction (form b), greater than -1; instead of `rate`, `compounding` and `payment_frequency`. |
| `number_of_instalments` | integer | sì |  | Number of instalments, from 1 to 10000. |
| `timing` | `ordinary` \| `due` | sì |  | `ordinary` (in arrears: instalment k at the end of period k) or `due` (in advance: at the beginning of period k). |
| `balloon_amount` | decimale | no |  | Amount repaid at the end of the last period on top of the last instalment, in currency units, at least 0 and lower than the principal. Default: 0. |
| `rounding` |  | no |  | Rounding of the instalment. Default: none (no rounding). |

**Number of instalments of a loan** · versione del metodo 1 · stato disponibile · tool `fairmark_loans_number_of_instalments`

Number of instalments needed to repay a loan with a given instalment, the exact number of periods and the final instalment.

| Input | Tipo | Obbligatorio | Default | Descrizione |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `principal` | decimale | sì |  | Amount borrowed, in currency units, greater than zero. |
| `rate` | decimale | no |  | Annual borrowing rate, decimal fraction (0.05 = 5% a year), quoted with `compounding`. Rate form (a): give it with `compounding` and `payment_frequency`, or give `periodic_rate` instead. |
| `compounding` |  | no |  | Compounding of `rate` (form a); required with `rate`, no default. |
| `payment_frequency` |  | no |  | Instalments per year (form a): `annual`, `semi_annual`, `quarterly` or `monthly`. |
| `periodic_rate` | decimale | no |  | Rate per payment period, decimal fraction (form b), greater than -1; instead of `rate`, `compounding` and `payment_frequency`. |
| `instalment` | decimale | sì |  | Constant instalment, in currency units; it must exceed the interest of the first period. |

## `loans.amortisation_schedule`

**Amortisation schedule (French, constant principal, bullet)** · versione del metodo 1 · stato disponibile · tool `fairmark_loans_amortisation_schedule`

Period-by-period schedule of a loan with instalment, interest portion, principal portion and outstanding balance; French, fixed amortisation schedule or bullet, with an optional grace period, balloon amount and rounding.

| Input | Tipo | Obbligatorio | Default | Descrizione |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `principal` | decimale | sì |  | Amount borrowed, in currency units, greater than zero. |
| `rate` | decimale | no |  | Annual borrowing rate, decimal fraction (0.05 = 5% a year), quoted with `compounding`. Rate form (a): give it with `compounding` and `payment_frequency`, or give `periodic_rate` instead. |
| `compounding` |  | no |  | Compounding of `rate` (form a); required with `rate`, no default. |
| `payment_frequency` |  | no |  | Instalments per year (form a): `annual`, `semi_annual`, `quarterly` or `monthly`. |
| `periodic_rate` | decimale | no |  | Rate per payment period, decimal fraction (form b), greater than -1; instead of `rate`, `compounding` and `payment_frequency`. |
| `number_of_instalments` | integer | sì |  | Number of instalments over the full term, grace periods included, from 1 to 10000. |
| `timing` | `ordinary` \| `due` | sì |  | `ordinary` (in arrears: instalment k at the end of period k, time k). Version 1 accepts only `ordinary`; `due` is refused with `FM-E001`. |
| `amortisation_type` | `french` \| `fixed_amortisation_schedule` \| `bullet` | sì |  | `french` (constant instalment), `fixed_amortisation_schedule` (constant principal portion) or `bullet` (principal repaid with the last instalment). |
| `principal_grace_periods` | integer \| null | no |  | Number of interest-only periods at the start, lower than `number_of_instalments`. Default: 0. Not accepted with `bullet`. |
| `balloon_amount` | decimale | no |  | Principal repaid with the last instalment on top of the amortised amount, in currency units, at least 0 and lower than the principal. Default: 0. Not accepted with `bullet`. |
| `rounding` |  | no |  | Rounding of the amount the schedule type keeps constant: the instalment (`french`) or the principal portion (`fixed_amortisation_schedule`). Interest is never rounded. Default: none (no rounding). |

## `coc.cost_of_equity`

**Cost of equity (CAPM with explicit premia)** · versione del metodo 1 · stato disponibile · tool `fairmark_coc_cost_of_equity`

Cost of equity from risk-free rate, levered or relevered beta and equity risk premium, plus optional country, size and specific premia, each reported.

| Input | Tipo | Obbligatorio | Default | Descrizione |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `risk_free_rate` | decimale | sì |  | Risk-free rate, annual decimal fraction. |
| `equity_risk_premium` | decimale | sì |  | Equity risk premium of the market, annual decimal fraction. |
| `levered_beta` | decimale | no |  | Levered beta, dimensionless. Give exactly one of `levered_beta` and `relever`. |
| `relever` |  | no |  | Unlevered beta and target structure to relever. Give exactly one of `levered_beta` and `relever`. |
| `country_risk_premium` | decimale | no |  | Country risk premium, annual decimal fraction, not negative. Default: 0. |
| `country_exposure` | decimale | no |  | Exposure of the company to the country risk (lambda), dimensionless, not negative. Default: 1. |
| `size_premium` | decimale | no |  | Size premium, annual decimal fraction. Default: 0. |
| `specific_risk_premium` | decimale | no |  | Company-specific risk premium, annual decimal fraction. Default: 0. When not zero, `specific_risk_justification` is required. |
| `specific_risk_justification` | string \| null | no |  | Written reason for the specific risk premium, echoed in the audit trail. |

## `coc.beta_relever`

**Beta unlevering and relevering** · versione del metodo 1 · stato disponibile · tool `fairmark_coc_beta_relever`

Converts an unlevered beta to a levered beta at a target D/E, or the reverse, with the Hamada or Harris-Pringle formula and an optional debt beta.

| Input | Tipo | Obbligatorio | Default | Descrizione |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `beta` | decimale | sì |  | Beta to convert (unlevered for `relever`, levered for `unlever`), dimensionless. |
| `direction` | `relever` \| `unlever` | sì |  | `relever` or `unlever`. |
| `debt_to_equity` | decimale | sì |  | Debt-to-equity ratio D/E, decimal (0.5 = debt equal to half of equity), not negative. |
| `tax_rate` | decimale | sì |  | Tax rate of the tax shield, decimal fraction from 0 to below 1. |
| `formula` | `hamada` \| `harris_pringle` | sì |  | `hamada` or `harris_pringle`. |
| `debt_beta` | decimale | no |  | Beta of debt, dimensionless. Default: 0 (risk-free debt). |

## `tv.gordon`

**Terminal value, stable growth (Gordon)** · versione del metodo 1 · stato disponibile · tool `fairmark_tv_gordon`

Terminal value at the horizon N of a flow growing at g forever, CF_{N+1} / (r − g), from the next flow or the last flow grown by g; not discounted.

| Input | Tipo | Obbligatorio | Default | Descrizione |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `rate` | decimale | sì |  | Discount rate of the terminal phase, decimal fraction per period; must exceed `growth`. It may differ from the rate of the explicit phase. |
| `growth` | decimale | sì |  | Perpetual growth of the flow, decimal fraction per period, greater than -1 and below `rate`. |
| `next_flow` | decimale | no |  | Flow of the first period after the horizon, CF_{N+1}, in currency units (for example a normalised flow). Give this or `last_flow`, not both. |
| `last_flow` | decimale | no |  | Flow of the last explicit period, CF_N, in currency units; grown by `growth` to CF_{N+1}. Give this or `next_flow`, not both. |
| `growth_cap` | decimale | no |  | Upper bound for the perpetual growth, decimal fraction per period (for example the risk-free rate or the nominal growth of the economy). Default: none, reported as absent. A growth above the cap is reported, not refused. |

## `tv.value_driver`

**Terminal value, value driver (growth from reinvestment)** · versione del metodo 1 · stato disponibile · tool `fairmark_tv_value_driver`

Terminal value at the horizon N with growth earned by reinvesting g / RONIC of NOPAT: NOPAT_{N+1} × (1 − g / RONIC) / (r − g); reports the reinvestment rate and whether growth creates value.

| Input | Tipo | Obbligatorio | Default | Descrizione |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `nopat_next` | decimale | sì |  | Net operating profit after tax of the first period after the horizon, NOPAT_{N+1}, in currency units. |
| `growth` | decimale | sì |  | Perpetual growth, decimal fraction per period, greater than -1 and below `rate`. |
| `ronic` | decimale | sì |  | Return on new invested capital (RONIC), decimal fraction per period, greater than 0. |
| `rate` | decimale | sì |  | Discount rate of the terminal phase, decimal fraction per period; must exceed `growth`. |
| `growth_cap` | decimale | no |  | Upper bound for the perpetual growth, decimal fraction per period. Default: none, reported as absent. A growth above the cap is reported, not refused. |

## `tv.h_model`

**Terminal value, H-model (declining growth)** · versione del metodo 1 · stato disponibile · tool `fairmark_tv_h_model`

Terminal value at the horizon N when growth declines linearly from g_s to g_l over 2H periods: CF_N × [(1 + g_l) + H × (g_s − g_l)] / (r − g_l), an approximation.

| Input | Tipo | Obbligatorio | Default | Descrizione |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `last_flow` | decimale | sì |  | Flow of the last explicit period, CF_N, in currency units. |
| `short_term_growth` | decimale | sì |  | Growth at the start of the decline, g_s, decimal fraction per period, greater than -1. |
| `long_term_growth` | decimale | sì |  | Stable growth reached after 2H periods and kept forever, g_l, decimal fraction per period, greater than -1 and below `rate`. |
| `half_life` | decimale | sì |  | Half-life H, in periods: the decline from g_s to g_l lasts 2H periods. Zero or positive; may be fractional. |
| `rate` | decimale | sì |  | Discount rate of the terminal phase, decimal fraction per period; must exceed `long_term_growth`. |
| `growth_cap` | decimale | no |  | Upper bound for the long-term growth, decimal fraction per period. Default: none, reported as absent. A growth above the cap is reported, not refused. |

## `tv.exit_multiple`

**Terminal value, exit multiple** · versione del metodo 1 · stato disponibile · tool `fairmark_tv_exit_multiple`

Terminal value at the horizon N as a multiple of EBITDA, EBIT, revenue (enterprise basis), earnings or book value of equity (equity basis); with a rate and the next flow, reports the implied perpetual growth.

| Input | Tipo | Obbligatorio | Default | Descrizione |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `multiple` | decimale | sì |  | The multiple, a pure number greater than 0 (for example 8 for 8 × EBITDA). |
| `metric` | `ebitda` \| `ebit` \| `revenue` \| `earnings` \| `book_value` | sì |  | `ebitda`, `ebit`, `revenue` (enterprise basis), `earnings` or `book_value` (equity basis). |
| `metric_value` | decimale | sì |  | The metric at the horizon N, in currency units, greater than 0. |
| `rate` | decimale | no |  | Discount rate of the terminal phase, decimal fraction per period, on the basis of the metric (WACC for enterprise, cost of equity for equity). Optional, with `next_flow`: both or neither. Used only for the implied growth. |
| `next_flow` | decimale | no |  | Flow at N + 1 on the basis of the metric (FCFF for enterprise, FCFE for equity), in currency units. Optional, with `rate`: both or neither. |
| `growth_cap` | decimale | no |  | Upper bound for the implied growth, decimal fraction per period. Default: none, reported as absent. Needs `rate` and `next_flow`. Exceeding it is reported, not refused. |

## `tv.limited_horizon`

**Terminal value, finite horizon** · versione del metodo 1 · stato disponibile · tool `fairmark_tv_limited_horizon`

Terminal value at the horizon N of a flow lasting n more periods, constant or growing, plus a residual value at N + n (Italian practice); reuses the annuity factor of tvm.annuity.

| Input | Tipo | Obbligatorio | Default | Descrizione |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `flow` | decimale | sì |  | First flow after the horizon, at the end of period N + 1, in currency units. |
| `rate` | decimale | sì |  | Discount rate of the terminal phase, decimal fraction per period, greater than -1. |
| `periods` | integer | sì |  | Number of further periods n during which the flow lasts, from 1 to 10000. |
| `growth` | decimale | no |  | Growth of the flow per period, decimal fraction, greater than -1. Default: 0 (constant flow). |
| `residual_value` | decimale | no |  | Residual value at the end of period N + n, in currency units. Default: 0. |
| `growth_cap` | decimale | no |  | Upper bound for the growth, decimal fraction per period. Default: none, reported as absent. A growth above the cap is reported, not refused. |

## `tv.normalised_income`

**Terminal value, capitalised normalised income** · versione del metodo 1 · stato disponibile · tool `fairmark_tv_normalised_income`

Terminal value at the horizon N as a normalised income capitalised at a rate i, R / i, or R / (i − g) with growth (Italian practice).

| Input | Tipo | Obbligatorio | Default | Descrizione |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `income` | decimale | sì |  | Normalised income R of the first period after the horizon, in currency units. |
| `capitalisation_rate` | decimale | sì |  | Capitalisation rate i, decimal fraction per period, greater than 0; must exceed `growth`. |
| `basis` | `enterprise` \| `equity` | sì |  | `enterprise` (an operating income capitalised at a rate for all capital providers) or `equity` (a net income capitalised at a cost of equity). Required, no default. |
| `growth` | decimale | no |  | Perpetual growth of the income, decimal fraction per period, greater than -1 and below the capitalisation rate. Default: none (R / i). |
| `growth_cap` | decimale | no |  | Upper bound for the growth, decimal fraction per period. Default: none, reported as absent. A growth above the cap is reported, not refused. |

## `tv.liquidation`

**Terminal value, liquidation** · versione del metodo 1 · stato disponibile · tool `fairmark_tv_liquidation`

Net liquidation value at the horizon N: realisable values of labelled assets less labelled liabilities, liquidation costs and the tax on gains, every line in explain.

| Input | Tipo | Obbligatorio | Default | Descrizione |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `assets` | lista di object | sì |  | Assets with their realisable values at N, in currency units, each zero or positive; at least one. |
| `liabilities` | lista di object | sì |  | Liabilities settled at N, in currency units, each zero or positive. |
| `liquidation_costs` | lista di object | sì |  | Costs of the liquidation (legal fees, closure, severance), in currency units, each zero or positive. |
| `tax_on_gains` | decimale | sì |  | Tax on the gains realised, as an amount in currency units, zero or positive. |
| `basis` | `enterprise` \| `equity` | sì |  | `enterprise` (the liabilities listed exclude financial debt: the value is an enterprise value) or `equity` (financial debt included: the value is an equity value). Required, no default. |

## `tv.compare`

**Terminal value, comparison of techniques** · versione del metodo 1 · stato disponibile · tool `fairmark_tv_compare`

Runs several terminal value techniques on one rate, growth cap and basis and returns each terminal value at the horizon N with its implied assumptions, side by side.

| Input | Tipo | Obbligatorio | Default | Descrizione |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `rate` | decimale | sì |  | Discount rate of the terminal phase, decimal fraction per period, shared by every technique that uses a discount rate. |
| `basis` | `enterprise` \| `equity` | sì |  | `enterprise` or `equity`: the basis of every terminal value compared. An exit multiple of the other basis is refused. |
| `growth_cap` | decimale | no |  | Upper bound for the perpetual growth, decimal fraction per period, shared by every growth-based technique. Default: none, reported as absent. |
| `techniques` | lista di  | sì |  | Techniques to run, at least one, each written `{"tv.<name>": {terms}}`; the same technique may appear more than once. |

## `dcf.fcff`

**DCF — unlevered free cash flow** · versione del metodo 3 · stato anteprima · tool `fairmark_dcf_fcff`

Value of operations, enterprise value and equity value from FCFF discounted at the WACC over one to three explicit stages (given flows, constant growth, linear decline of growth) and a terminal value by a tv.* technique on the enterprise basis (stable growth, H-model, value driver, exit multiple, finite horizon, normalised income, liquidation). Returns every period and step for audit.

| Input | Tipo | Obbligatorio | Default | Descrizione |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `stages` | lista di object | sì |  | One to three explicit stages, in order; the explicit horizon N is the sum of their periods. Each stage is `{"periods", "projection", ...}` with the fields of its projection. |
| `base_flow` | decimale | no |  | FCFF of the base period CF_0, in currency units: required when the first stage is `constant_growth` or `linear_decline`, refused when it is `given`. |
| `notional_tax_rate` | decimale | no |  | For stages with `lines`: tax rate applied to EBIT, decimal fraction from 0 to below 1 (0.24 = 24%). Give this, or `operating_taxes` in every line, not both; refused when no stage has `lines`. Default: none. |
| `negative_ebit` |  | no |  | For stages with `lines` and `notional_tax_rate`: treatment of a negative EBIT, `credit` (taxes = rate × EBIT) or `zero` (no tax); required with `notional_tax_rate`, no default. |
| `cash_flow_terms` | `nominal` \| `real` | sì |  | `nominal` or `real`: the terms of every amount and growth rate of the input. |
| `discount_rate_terms` | `nominal` \| `real` | sì |  | `nominal` or `real`: the terms of the discount rates. When they differ from `cash_flow_terms`, expected inflation is required (`inflation`, or `inflation_per_period` with `terminal_inflation`) and every rate is converted to the terms of the cash flows; the cash flows are never converted. |
| `inflation` | decimale | no |  | Expected inflation, decimal fraction per period (0.02 = 2%), greater than -1, for every explicit period and for the terminal phase. Give this or `inflation_per_period`, or neither. With different terms it converts the discount rates by the exact Fisher relation; with equal terms it only restates the perpetual growth in the other terms. Default: none. |
| `inflation_per_period` | array \| null | no |  | Expected inflation per period of the explicit horizon, decimal fractions, exactly N of them, each greater than -1; requires `terminal_inflation`. Give this or `inflation`, not both. Default: none. |
| `terminal_inflation` | decimale | no |  | Expected inflation of the terminal phase, decimal fraction per period, greater than -1; required with `inflation_per_period`, refused otherwise. |
| `wacc` | decimale | no |  | One WACC for every period and for the terminal value, decimal fraction per period (0.09 = 9%), greater than -1. Give this or `wacc_per_period`, not both. |
| `wacc_per_period` | array \| null | no |  | One WACC per period of the explicit horizon, decimal fractions, exactly N of them; requires `terminal_wacc`. Give this or `wacc`, not both. |
| `terminal_wacc` | decimale | no |  | WACC of the terminal phase, decimal fraction per period; required with `wacc_per_period`, refused with `wacc`. |
| `timing` | `end_of_period` \| `mid_period` | sì |  | `end_of_period` (flow k at t = k) or `mid_period` (t = k − 0.5); no default. |
| `terminal_discount_time` |  | no |  | With `mid_period` timing, required: `horizon` (terminal value at t = N) or `mid_period` (t = N − 0.5). Refused with `end_of_period`. |
| `terminal` | object | sì |  | The terminal technique, an object with exactly one key, the method id, for example `{"tv.gordon": {"growth", "first_flow", ...}}`: `tv.gordon`, `tv.h_model`, `tv.value_driver`, `tv.exit_multiple`, `tv.limited_horizon`, `tv.normalised_income` or `tv.liquidation`, on the enterprise basis. |
| `net_financial_position` |  | no |  | Net financial position at the valuation date (SPEC-0007): gross debt − cash + signed other items, positive for net debt, subtracted from enterprise value. Default: none, reported. |
| `non_operating_assets` | lista di object | no |  | Non-operating assets at the valuation date, each a label and a value in currency units (zero or more), added to the value of operations. Default: none, reported. |
| `debt_like_items` | lista di object | no |  | Debt-like items (debt equivalents) at the valuation date, for example unfunded pension obligations or provisions, each a label, a value in currency units (zero or more) and its measurement basis, subtracted from enterprise value. Do not repeat an item already among the `other_items` of the net financial position. Default: none, reported. |
| `non_controlling_interests` | lista di object | no |  | Non-controlling interests (minority interests) at the valuation date, each a label, a value in currency units (zero or more) and its measurement basis (for example `book_value` or `fair_value`), subtracted from enterprise value. Default: none, reported. |

## `dcf.free_cash_flows`

**Free cash flow build-up (FCFF and FCFE)** · versione del metodo 1 · stato anteprima · tool `fairmark_dcf_free_cash_flows`

FCFF per period from EBIT, taxes on EBIT (a rate or amounts), depreciation and amortisation, capital expenditure, change in net working capital and labelled adjustments; FCFE when interest expense and net borrowing are given. Not discounted.

| Input | Tipo | Obbligatorio | Default | Descrizione |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `periods` | lista di object | sì |  | Line items of periods 1..n, in order; at least one period. |
| `notional_tax_rate` | decimale | no |  | Tax rate applied to EBIT, decimal fraction from 0 to below 1 (0.24 = 24%) (rate form). Give this or `operating_taxes` in every period, not both. Default: none. |
| `negative_ebit` |  | no |  | Treatment of a negative EBIT in the rate form: `credit` (taxes = rate × EBIT) or `zero` (no tax). Required with `notional_tax_rate`, there is no default; not accepted with `operating_taxes`. Tax loss carry-forwards are not modelled. |
| `interest_tax_rate` | decimale | no |  | Tax rate t of the interest tax shield in the FCFE, decimal fraction from 0 to below 1. Required when the taxes are given as `operating_taxes` and the financing lines are given; not accepted otherwise (with `notional_tax_rate` the shield uses that rate). |

## `ratios.covenants`

**Ratios — covenants** · versione del metodo 1 · stato anteprima · tool `fairmark_ratios_covenants`

Tests financial covenants on the numerator and denominator defined by the loan agreement, against a threshold with an explicit operator (at most, less than, at least, greater than) at a test date. The agreement's own rules are explicit inputs: the outcome when the denominator is zero or negative, and the rounding of the tested value. Returns for each covenant the outcome (passed, breached, or not tested with a code and the reason), decided exactly, the tested value and the headroom, absolute and relative to the threshold.

| Input | Tipo | Obbligatorio | Default | Descrizione |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `covenants` | lista di object | sì |  | The covenants to test, at least one. Each is tested on its own; the results keep this order. |

## `analysis.goal_seek`

**Goal seek** · versione del metodo 1 · stato disponibile · tool `fairmark_analysis_goal_seek`

Value of one decimal input of any method at which one of its outputs equals a target, found with Brent's method in an explicit bracket; every evaluation is reported.

| Input | Tipo | Obbligatorio | Default | Descrizione |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `method` | string | sì |  | Id of the method to evaluate, for example `dcf.fcff`. Analysis methods are not accepted. |
| `base_input` | object | sì |  | Input of that method, complete, including the variable at any starting value. |
| `variable` | string | sì |  | RFC 6901 JSON Pointer to the decimal input to solve for, for example `/discount_rate`. |
| `output` | string | sì |  | RFC 6901 JSON Pointer to the decimal output of the method, in its `value`, for example `/enterprise_value`. |
| `target` | decimale | sì |  | Value the output must reach, in the output's units. |
| `bracket` | lista di decimale | sì |  | `[low, high]`, low < high: the variable is searched in this interval, and the output minus the target must change sign between its ends (or meet the tolerance at one end). |
| `tolerance` | decimale | no | `"0.000000001"` | Absolute tolerance on the output, in the output's units, greater than 0. Default: 0.000000001. |
| `max_iterations` | integer | no | `100` | Largest number of evaluations after the two bracket ends, from 1 to 1000. Default: 100. |

| `columns` |  | no |  | Optional second variable, along the columns, different from the row variable. Absent: a one-way table (one column). |
